snippet.title: FREE Co-op Cat Steam Game! 🐾 Steal Your Friends' Crops!
snippet.description:
FREE Co-op Cat Steam Game! 🐾 Steal Your Friends' Crops!
To the steam！
Wishlist "Meow My Crop!" on Steam NOW! 🐾
Turn your desktop into a cozy cat farm! 🐱🌱
Whether you're working or studying, your cat is here to help you grow crops (and maybe steal some from your friends!).
✨ Why you'll love it:
FREE Co-op: Farm with friends or raid their gardens! 🤝
Productivity Booster: Click & Type to grow. Perfect for work-from-home! 💻
Mac Supported: Fully optimized for macOS, Controllers, and even MIDI! 🎹
Customization: Unlock cute outfits with cat cans! 👗
Coming Q2 2026! Every Wishlist helps us grow. Thank you for the support!
